permissions.title: Camera and microphone access
permissions.description: For video calls, the site needs access to the <camera>camera</camera> and <mic>microphone</mic> so others can see and hear you. Permissions are requested only for the call — you can turn off the camera or microphone anytime in the call UI.

chrome.title: Chrome and other Chromium-based browsers (Edge, Brave, etc.)
chrome.step1: Click the lock or settings icon to the left of the address bar.
chrome.step2: Find the Camera and Microphone options.
chrome.step3: Choose Allow for this site and refresh the page if needed.

edge.title: Microsoft Edge
edge.step1: Click the lock or settings icon to the left of the address bar.
edge.step2: In permissions, set Allow for camera and microphone.
edge.step3: If needed, check Windows settings: Settings → Privacy → Camera and Microphone.

firefox.title: Firefox
firefox.step1: Click the shield or lock icon to the left of the address bar.
firefox.step3: Allow Use the Camera and Use the Microphone.

safari.title: Safari
safari.step1: Click the aA icon or the site name in the address bar.
safari.step3: For Camera and Microphone, choose Allow.
